picks.title: OpenAI researcher Miles Wang in talks to launch AI drug discovery startup valued at $2B
picks.why_it_matters: A top AI researcher spinning out of OpenAI to apply frontier models to drug discovery signals continued talent migration from foundation model labs into vertical AI applications—a trend creating both co-investment opportunities and competitive intelligence on where elite builders see the highest-leverage problems.

picks.title: Exclusive: Google's Hassabis calls for U.S.-led global AI watchdog
picks.why_it_matters: A major AI lab CEO publicly advocating for coordinated slowdowns and screening of advanced models could foreshadow regulatory frameworks that reshape compute access, model deployment timelines, and competitive dynamics for AI startups across sectors.

picks.title: Bonsai 27B: A 27B-Class model that runs on a phone
picks.why_it_matters: Capable models running locally on consumer hardware fundamentally shifts the build-vs-API calculus for AI-native startups, enabling new categories of privacy-first, offline-capable, and latency-sensitive applications without cloud inference costs.
